title: Presenting symptoms and provoked angina: an uncertain interaction across two angiography cohorts
abstract: Across independently collected Cleveland and Hungarian angiography cohorts (303 source,293 target), adding the conjunction of asymptomatic presenting chest-pain category and exercise-induced angina to flexible additive predictors changed target Brier error by -0.002922 (joint bootstrap95% interval [-0.011469,0.006166]); incremental benefit was not established.
